# who is my sample
## gender, sexual ID

```{r}
table(data_full$trans)

view(data_full %>%
       group_by(trans)%>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    man = sum(man, na.rm = TRUE), 
    woman = sum(woman, na.rm = TRUE),
    gqueer       = sum(gqueer, na.rm = TRUE),
    g_other = sum(g_other, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

view(data_full %>%
  group_by(man) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

view(data_full %>%
  group_by(woman) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

view(data_full %>%
  group_by(gqueer) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))


view(data_full %>%
  group_by(g_other) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
```

*don't really have gender data for those excluded

## state, county

```{r}
install.packages("usmap")
library(usmap)


data_full %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
  n = n())


view(data_full %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

```
